title: Provision of NSSAI to lower layers in 5GMM-IDLE mode

entities.name: NSSAI inclusion mode IE
entities.description: Information element in REGISTRATION ACCEPT message that indicates which NSSAI inclusion mode the UE shall operate in for the current access within the current PLMN or SNPN.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI
entities.description: Network slice selection assistance information requested by the UE.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Network slice selection assistance information allowed by the network.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message from AMF to UE that may include the NSSAI inclusion mode IE.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message sent by UE in 5GMM-IDLE mode that may trigger NSSAI provision to lower layers.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message that may trigger NSSAI provision to lower layers depending on NSSAI inclusion mode.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: 5G mobility management state where UE may send initial NAS messages and provide NSSAI to lower layers.

entities.name: NSSAI inclusion mode storage
entities.description: UE stores the NSSAI inclusion mode together with PLMN/SNPN identity and access type in non-volatile memory.

entities.name: Emergency services condition
entities.description: Condition where no NSSAI is provided to lower layers for emergency services, onboarding services, or specific message types.

relations.description: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain the NSSAI inclusion mode IE.
NSSAI inclusion mode IE determines whether Requested NSSAI is provided to lower layers.
NSSAI inclusion mode IE determines whether Allowed NSSAI is provided to lower layers.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message is sent when UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode.
SERVICE REQUEST message is sent when UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode.
Emergency services condition establishes that no NSSAI is provided to lower layers.
NSSAI inclusion mode storage property is defined by the NSSAI inclusion mode IE.
